career_roadmap.action: Submit application using the qwen2.5:14b version, focusing on transferable skills (project management, stakeholder alignment) and expressing eagerness to upskill in required tech stack (JavaScript/Python/React).

Enroll in free/low-cost courses (e.g., freeCodeCamp, Coursera's Python for Everybody) to gain proficiency in JavaScript, Python, and fullstack frameworks. Complete personal projects (e.g., portfolio website, simple SaaS tool).
Apply for remote internships or freelance gigs at early-stage startups to gain hands-on experience with agile workflows, MVP development, and startup-specific challenges.
Earn a certification (e.g., Google's Professional Certificate in Full Stack Development) to validate technical skills and demonstrate commitment to the field.

After 6-12 months of technical upskilling and startup experience, apply for Senior Fullstack Engineer roles at scaleups, emphasizing leadership experience from previous roles (e.g., managing teams, driving project outcomes).
